item.title: Trump-allied Kennedy Center board votes to put his name back on building
item.description: The Kennedy Center board voted Thursday to restore President Trump's name to the John F. Kennedy Center for the Performing Arts, according to multiple reports.

item.title: Longtime House Democrats face primary backlash in midterm wave
item.description: Democratic incumbents who have held their seats for decades are seeing a shift as primary voters demand change, challenging their political stability.

item.title: White House renovation costs continue to climb
item.description: The East Wing has been removed, a new helipad is expanding, and scaffolding covers the front columns, with the total price for the project rising.

item.title: Musk and Zuckerberg rejoin AI race with new model advances
item.description: Elon Musk and Mark Zuckerberg have regained ground in the AI sector, overcoming earlier setbacks to narrow the gap with leading Silicon Valley firms.
